messages:
Samir: Heads up — noticed a token-mix shift over the last 6 weeks. Median context length on hosted gen requests has moved from ~1k -> ~3k tokens, tail up to 16k. This is already pushing up GPU-hours in prod. :warning:
Anya: ugh — any idea if it's one app or broad?
Kevin: it's across 3 customers (search augmentation, chatbots, and an internal analytics job). Streaming usage also doubled for chat flows.
Li: streaming vs non-streaming matters a lot for batching. Streaming keeps smaller per-request batches which reduces GPU utilization efficiency.
Marco: do we have a quick back-of-envelope on GPU-hour impact?
Samir: rough numbers from last week: average tokens/sec per GPU dropped ~20% because KV cache growth increases memory pressure & evicts batching windows. If we normalize to token-hours:
```
Observed: 1M token-hours/day -> used to be ~0.9 GPU-hours/day on quantized LlamaX.
Now: 1.8M token-hours/day -> ~1.8 GPU-hours/day (streaming ineff + longer context)
Net: ~2x GPU-hours on same QPS for these workloads.
```
Anya: hmm — that would blow committed capacity for Dedicated customers if sustained. Any regional hotspots?
Kevin: APAC region saw the largest context jump (avg 4k). NA is ~2.5k. EU mostly stable.
Li: network-wise, streaming increases RTT sensitivity. We've seen higher retransmits from one cloud provider in APAC — that amplifies long-tail latency and kills batching.
ops-bot: [alert] node-gpu-pool-3 in apac-west reported memory-pressure at 2025-11-16T03:12:22Z, autoscaler kicked extra nodes +2
Marco: is the autoscaler handling it gracefully? costs spiked yesterday by ~18% for the pool.
Samir: autoscaler added nodes but slower because of available instance cold starts in that region. We fell back to lower-throughput model variants for some routes to keep latency SLOs.
Anya: we should quantify two levers: (1) streaming-first optimization (enable multi-request batching inside stream sessions), (2) incentivize customers to use chunked non-streaming for long contexts.
Kevin: proposal: for next 30 days run an A/B where: 
- group A: current config
- group B: enable aggressive prefix caching + enable `stream_batch_window_ms=100` in runtime
Metrics to track: tokens/sec per GPU, median latency, 99p latency, GPU-hours, and cost per token.
Li: small note: prefix caching will need KV cache hot-reload logic to avoid cache storms on scale-up. I can sketch changes.
Marco: also consider temporary regional capacity shift: move some burst capacity from NA -> APAC for the next 8 weeks. Need cost estimate.
Samir: quick cost delta estimate: extra 1.0 GPU-hour/day in APAC pool = ~$24/day on our committed vs on-demand mix, so 30 days ~ $720. If sustained + autoscaler ineffs, could be 2-3x.
Anya: thanks. Also check Dedicated customer contracts — if we drain committed capacity they'll get throttled and we may face credits.
Kevin: action items: 
- Kevin + Li: run the A/B and instrument `tokens_per_gpu_hour` metric (start today) 
- Marco: run regional capacity simulation and pricing delta for APAC shift (due EOD tomorrow)
- Samir: prepare comms for affected customers with suggested mitigations (non-streaming batch hints, smaller chunk sizes)
Anya: pinging @here for awareness. If we see sustained trend, product needs to expose a "context-length advisory" in Console. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Li: small debug snippet to enable stream batching on runtime side:
```
# runtime config snippet
stream_batch_window_ms: 100
max_stream_batch_size: 32
enable_prefix_cache: true
```
Samir: FYI I also saved a short trace from a heavy APAC session — attaching in thread (log snippet):
```
[2025-11-15T22:11:02Z] req=abc123 ctx=12k tokens latency=1.8s batch_wait=120ms evicted_kv_pages=4
[2025-11-15T22:11:03Z] req=abc124 ctx=14k tokens latency=2.4s batch_wait=300ms evicted_kv_pages=10
```
Marco: ok — we need to be careful with changing model variants (quality regressions). Any fallback plan?
Kevin: yes: canary route with traffic shadowing + automatic rollback on quality regressions (we already have eval hooks).
Anya: final: schedule 30-min sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC to review A/B plan and customer impact. If anyone can't make it, DM me. :thumbsup:
Samir: thanks all — I'll start a short runbook for ops playbooks if the spike persists.
ops-bot: [note] meeting created: "Context & Streaming Capacity — A/B plan" 2025-11-17T10:00:00Z
Kevin: will add dashboards (tokens_per_gpu_hour, stream_batch_hit_rate, apac-node-start-latency).
Li: I'll prepare a small patch for cache hot-reload logic to avoid stampedes.
Anya: perfect. we'll reconvene after initial A/B results. :rocket:
